portfolio.title: Professional Portfolio
portfolio.description: A personal React portfolio built to showcase my projects, skills, and experience, focused on a modern, responsive, and interactive interface.
portfolio.fullDescription: I built this portfolio as a way to present my work and my growth in software development. The app was designed with more than visuals in mind — navigation experience matters too — so I used animations, transitions, and reusable components to create a more dynamic feel.
features: Responsive design for mobile, tablet, and desktop
Vite-optimized build for fast loading times
portfolio.challenges: Balancing a rich animated look (Framer Motion, gradients, glassmorphism effects) without compromising load performance and smoothness on low-end devices.
portfolio.solution: Lightweight, reusable components, lazy-loaded assets, and fine-tuned Framer Motion transitions to keep 60fps even on simpler screens.
portfolio.objective: Serve as a technical business card, demonstrating mastery of React, animations, and UI/UX best practices.

gestao.title: Sales Management System
gestao.description: A web system designed to organize sales, customers, and business information in a single platform.
gestao.fullDescription: A web app built for sales teams, making it possible to register customers, record sales, and track daily commercial flow in an organized way. The goal was to replace manual controls (scattered spreadsheets) with one centralized interface.
features: Whole sales flow organized in one screen
Interface designed for quick daily use
gestao.challenges: Structuring sales and customer data neatly using only base technologies (plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript) with no framework to manage state.
gestao.solution: Careful data modeling in JavaScript and direct DOM manipulation to keep the interface reactive and synchronized with stored information.
gestao.objective: Ease the sales team's routine by reducing errors and rework caused by scattered manual controls.

watchhub.title: Watch Hub
watchhub.description: An app to register, manage, and compare watches.
watchhub.fullDescription: Built for watch collectors and enthusiasts, the app lets you register collection pieces, organize each model's details, and compare them side by side to support buying decisions — or simply keep your collection in order.
features: Side-by-side comparison of two or more watches
Visual organization of the user's collection
Reactive interface built with React components
watchhub.challenges: Building a comparison logic that is visually clear, highlighting differences between models without cluttering the screen with too much information.
watchhub.solution: Splitting the interface into independent per-watch components and using React state to sync the selection and the comparative view in real time.
watchhub.objective: Provide a simple, visual tool to organize and compare collection items.

publibus.title: PUBLI-BUS
publibus.description: A platform for managing bus advertising, controlling advertisers, campaigns, and ad spaces.
publibus.fullDescription: A system designed to simplify the management of advertising campaigns on buses. The platform centralizes advertiser, campaign, and ad-space data, offering an admin interface to track and organize operations more efficiently.
features: Control of display spaces and devices
publibus.challenges: Building a complete application that connects the frontend to the backend and the database while keeping data secure, organized, and in sync.
publibus.solution: A full stack architecture using React on the frontend, Node.js and Express on the backend, Prisma for database access, and authentication for access control.
publibus.objective: Create a centralized platform for managing bus advertising, making advertiser and campaign control more organized and efficient.

aresportes.title: AR Esportes
aresportes.description: An institutional site for a judo academy, presenting the brand and its disciplines.
aresportes.fullDescription: An institutional landing page for a judo academy, designed to present the brand, the disciplines offered, and contact channels in a clear, direct, and responsive way — helping to bring in new students.
features: Highlighted calls to action for contact and enrollment
aresportes.challenges: Conveying the identity and energy of a sports academy using only HTML, CSS, and JavaScript — no ready-made visual libraries.
aresportes.solution: Custom CSS focused on strong typography, contrasts, and straightforward sections, prioritizing the visitor's journey toward contact.
aresportes.objective: Grow the academy's digital presence and make first contact with prospective students easier.

advocacia.title: Bilobran & Palaci Law Firm
advocacia.description: An institutional site for a law firm, covering practice areas and contact info.
advocacia.fullDescription: An institutional website for a law firm, presenting practice areas, the firm's value proposition, and contact channels with a sober, professional look in line with the legal segment.
features: Presentation of the firm's practice areas
Responsive layout with a sober visual suited to the segment
advocacia.challenges: Adapting the visual language for an audience and segment outside the usual (legal), prioritizing seriousness and trust over flashy elements.
advocacia.solution: A more restrained palette and typography, focused on readability and clear organization of institutional and contact information.
advocacia.objective: Strengthen the firm's digital presence and convey credibility to potential clients.

cadastro.title: User Registration System
cadastro.description: A user registration and management app built with vanilla JavaScript.
cadastro.fullDescription: A user registration app built with vanilla JavaScript, featuring form validation and simple data persistence, designed to consolidate core DOM manipulation and validation concepts without depending on frameworks.
features: Listing and management of registered users
cadastro.challenges: Implementing robust form validation and data persistence without libraries, using only vanilla JavaScript.
cadastro.solution: Reusable validation functions and browser local storage to simulate persistence between sessions.
cadastro.objective: Reinforce vanilla JavaScript fundamentals applied to a real registration and validation case.

login.title: Login Interface
login.description: A modern authentication screen focused on conversion experience.
login.fullDescription: An authentication (login) screen designed with a modern look, smooth transitions, and a strong focus on user experience — prioritizing visual clarity and reducing friction in the sign-in flow.
features: Responsive layout for different screen sizes
Smooth transitions and micro-interactions on fields
Visual validation for email and password fields
Design focused on conversion and clarity
login.challenges: Creating an authentication experience that feels modern and pleasant without overdoing visual elements that could hurt usability.
login.solution: Subtle CSS/JS micro-interactions, clear visual hierarchy between fields and buttons, and usability tests focused on reducing fill friction.
login.objective: Demonstrate UI/UX best practices applied to a critical flow: user sign-in.
